doc.description:
INS and AHRS using the EKF2 of PX4.
The EKF2 and the PX4 libraries it needs are copied in sw/ext/px4_ekf2, where sync_px4_ekf2.py updates them to another PX4 version (see PX4_VERSION there).
All PX4 EKF2 parameters have their PX4 default and can be set in the airframe as INS_EKF2_name for the PX4 parameter EKF2_name (e.g. INS_EKF2_GPS_CTRL, INS_EKF2_HGT_REF, INS_EKF2_MAG_TYPE, INS_EKF2_EV_CTRL, INS_EKF2_OF_CTRL, INS_EKF2_EVP_NOISE, INS_EKF2_IMU_POS_X), and the GNSS checks as INS_EKF2_GNSS_name for GNSS_name (e.g. INS_EKF2_GNSS_REQ_EPH). See sw/ext/px4_ekf2/generated/ekf2_params.h and https://docs.px4.io/main/en/advanced_config/parameter_reference.html Sensors are only used when their data arrives, so a sensor enabled in a *_CTRL parameter without that sensor does nothing.
Airspeed and sideslip are only fused in fixed wing flight: always for the fixedwing firmware, and for hybrids flown with the rotorcraft firmware when they override ins_ekf2_fixed_wing_flight() (rotwing_state does this for the forward flight).

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_CTRL
define.description: GNSS fusion bitmask: 1 horizontal position, 2 vertical position, 4 velocity, 8 dual antenna heading (EKF2_GPS_CTRL_*)

define.name: INS_EKF2_HGT_REF
define.description: Height reference: 0 baro, 1 GNSS, 2 range finder, 3 external vision (EKF2_HGT_REF_*)

define.name: INS_EKF2_MAG_TYPE
define.description: Magnetometer: 0 automatic (heading on the ground, 3D in the air), 1 heading, 5 none, 6 only to initialize the heading (EKF2_MAG_TYPE_*)

define.name: INS_EKF2_EV_CTRL
define.description: External vision fusion bitmask: 1 horizontal position, 2 vertical position, 4 velocity, 8 yaw (EKF2_EV_CTRL_*)

define.name: INS_EKF2_OF_CTRL
define.description: Optical flow fusion

define.name: INS_EKF2_RNG_CTRL
define.description: Range finder height: 0 off, 1 conditional (low and slow), 2 always

define.name: INS_EKF2_DRAG_CTRL
define.description: Multirotor drag fusion (wind estimation without airspeed sensor)

define.name: INS_EKF2_IMU_CTRL
define.description: IMU bitmask: 1 gyro bias, 2 accel bias, 4 gravity vector fusion

define.name: INS_EKF2_ARSP_THR
define.description: Airspeed fusion above this true airspeed [m/s], 0 disables it (fixedwing default 8, set to 10 by rotwing_state)

define.name: INS_EKF2_FUSE_BETA
define.description: Synthetic sideslip fusion in fixed wing flight (fixedwing default 1, set by rotwing_state)

define.name: INS_EKF2_AIRSPEED_ID
define.description: ABI sender ID of the airspeed (do not use an airspeed computed from the wind estimate)

define.name: INS_EKF2_GNSS_CHECK
define.description: GNSS checks before the GNSS data is used (GNSS_CHECK_*), PX4 uses all except jamming (2047)

define.name: INS_EKF2_GNSS_REQ_EPH
define.description: Maximum horizontal position accuracy [m]

define.name: INS_EKF2_GNSS_REQ_EPV
define.description: Maximum vertical position accuracy [m]

define.name: INS_EKF2_GNSS_REQ_SACC
define.description: Maximum speed accuracy [m/s]

define.name: INS_EKF2_GNSS_REQ_NSATS
define.description: Required number of satellites

define.name: INS_EKF2_GNSS_REQ_PDOP
define.description: Maximum PDOP

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_DELAY
define.description: GNSS measurement delay [ms] (PX4 SENS_GNSS0_DELAY)

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_POS_X
define.description: GNSS antenna X offset from the CoG [m] (also _Y and _Z, PX4 SENS_GNSS0_OFF*)

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_YAW_OFFSET
define.description: Yaw of the dual antenna baseline in the body frame [deg], enables the GNSS heading from RELPOS

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_ANTENNA_DISTANCE
define.description: Distance between the two antennas of the dual antenna heading [m], the heading is only used when the measured distance is within INS_EKF2_GPS_ANTENNA_DISTANCE_ERR (not checked when not set)

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_ANTENNA_DISTANCE_ERR
define.description: Maximum difference between the measured and the configured antenna distance [m]

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_YAW_NOISE
define.description: GNSS heading noise when the receiver gives no accuracy [rad]

define.name: INS_EKF2_RNG_MIN_DIST
define.description: Minimum distance the range finder measures [m]

define.name: INS_EKF2_RNG_MAX_DIST
define.description: Maximum distance the range finder measures [m]

define.name: INS_EKF2_OF_MAX_RATE
define.description: Maximum flow rate the optical flow sensor measures [rad/s]

define.name: INS_EKF2_AGL_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used as input for AGL measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_BARO_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used ad input for Barometric measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_GYRO_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used as input for gyro measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_ACCEL_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used ad input for acceleration measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_MAG_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used as input for magnetic measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used ad input for GPS measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_RELPOS_ID
define.description: ABI sensor ID used ad input for Relative Position heading measurements

define.name: INS_EKF2_FORCE_NAV_REF
define.description: force to use the reference defined in the flight plan and not the one computed by the filter after first good GPS position

configure.name: USE_ALT_LLA_WAYPOINTS
configure.description: Use LLA altitude instead of LTP z for long distance flight (default=TRUE)
